cases.name: Karen Conner
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a life long South Jersey resident and graduate of Vineland High School. After graduation, she worked as a hair dresser, and then as a registered dental assistant for 30 years. She was known for her kindness and compassion to everyone, her ability to light up a room, her love for the beach, Disney and her family and friends."

cases.name: Christina Marie Asselta
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was born in Vineland and graduated from Sacred Heart High School Class of 2006. She attended Cumberland County College and earned a Bachelors Degree from Wilmington College. Christina worked at Larrys II for 22 years."
